version.changelog:
- Added detailed recommendations for when to use or not use WhiteMagic, clarifying its intended use cases.
- Included a proof section highlighting hosted lane features, uptime, payment options, and verifiable provenance.
- Removed the skill-card.md file.
- No changes to core functionality or API described.

llm.summary: This skill is a coherent local memory helper for coding agents, with durable storage and setup steps disclosed in the instructions.

dimensions.detail: The skill introduces a local MCP server and durable on-device memory, plus an optional hosted read-only recall path with OAuth; this is proportionate for memory continuity but users should understand what they store.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Installation uses a global npm package or native binary and can patch ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json or add an MCP server; these are disclosed setup actions and are consistent with an MCP memory integration.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions are scoped to using WhiteMagic memory, recommending it only for local durable memory, avoiding secrets, and treating recalled content as data rather than instructions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Persistent local memory and OpenClaw MCP configuration changes are central to the skill and are explicitly described; no hidden services, destructive actions, or exfiltration behavior were present in the artifact.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is durable local memory and session continuity, and the described MCP routes for recall, memory creation, updates, session records, and checkpoints match that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you want a durable memory layer for your coding agent. Review the external wm binary source before use, avoid storing credentials or secrets, and use the hosted option only if you are comfortable with OAuth and remote recall service terms.
